title: Microwave cannons used to bring down craft (Jake Barber / Northrop Grumman)

tellings.quote: if you look at Jake Barber, the psionics and all of that and you know, the Northre Grumand connection, they have in their possession a lot of those microwave cannons.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a man named Jake Barber, who has been tied to psionics (using the mind to affect the world) and to Northrop Grumman, a large US defense company. Michels says the people in that circle have a lot of microwave cannons, and suggests these are used to bring down unknown craft. If true, it would mean someone has a working way to knock such craft out of the sky.
